up: List all approved drugs (where max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary) whose mechanism of action has action_type = 'ACTIVATOR' in the drug_mechanism table. For each such drug, provide: the compound name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures), the mechanism description (mechanism_of_action from drug_mechanism), and target information including the target name (pref_name from target_dictionary) and the target organism (organism from target_dictionary). Do not add any other filters or limits.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, dm.mechanism_of_action AS mechanism_description, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'ACTIVATOR';
